name: Móvil: la hoja de estilos declara breakpoints responsive
description: La hoja de estilos global declara el comportamiento responsive del sitio: barra lateral oculta por defecto y visible en escritorio, drawer deslizante en pantallas pequeñas, cruce de publicación de bloque en el siguiente punto de corte y grillas que pasan a varias columnas. Verificación estática del CSS servido.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the stylesheet at /styles/style_global.css and inspect its raw text content
The stylesheet contains two responsive breakpoints declared with @media: one at min-width 768px and another at min-width 1024px
The .nav-drawer rule hides the drawer on small screens with transform: translateX(-100%) and the .nav-drawer.is-open rule shows it with transform: translateX(0)
At min-width 1024px the drawer is always visible (transform: translateX(0)) and the .mobile-brand is hidden (display: none)
The .concept-grid goes from a single column to two columns at min-width 768px, and the hero/list article rows reflow from stacked to side-by-side
